content: whatsapp-chat-parser (npm, Pustur) parseString(text, {daysFirst?, parseAttachments?}) -> Array of {date:Date, author, message, attachment?}. Infers day/month order via 3 methods, defaults daysFirst. Notes exports may be non-chronological (sort downstream). System messages have author null (v4) / 'System' (older). Handles multi-line via timestamp detection. No rendering, no media reconciliation.
